title: Promise to pay limits
text: A promise to pay may be booked if the borrower has fewer than two broken promises in 90 days and the promised date is within 15 days.

title: Contact pause
text: Outbound contact is paused until the promised date once a valid promise to pay is booked.

title: Ledger reconciliation
text: Where the borrower reports a payment, the ledger and payment gateway records are checked before any further collection contact.

title: Payment proof
text: If no payment is found, the borrower is asked for the transaction reference or receipt and standard cadence continues.

title: Schedule of charges
text: Late fees, penalties and bounce charges are applied only as per the published schedule of charges.

title: Charge reversal
text: Charges applied in error are reversed and the corrected statement is shared with the borrower.

title: Hardship handling
text: Borrowers reporting financial hardship, job loss or medical emergency are referred to a trained officer for restructuring assessment and contact is paused.

title: Fair practice
text: Collection contact follows fair practice norms: no harassment, restricted hours, and respectful language, with extra care for vulnerable customers.

title: Third-party contact
text: Loan details are never disclosed to a third party. Wrong-party contacts are logged and the number is removed from outreach.

title: Identity verification
text: Where identity is unclear, verification happens only through the registered channel before any disclosure.
